generate_raw_repre: generate a raw feature-based object representation from template images using a DINOv2 extractor
generate_repre: generate a complete object representation with PCA reduction, k-means clustering, and TF-IDF template descriptors
generate_repre_from_list: batch generate object representations for all object IDs in a specified BOP dataset
GenRepreOpts: configure feature extraction, PCA, clustering, and template descriptor options for object representation generation
main: run the object representation generation pipeline from command-line arguments or a JSON config file
